visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A dark, high-contrast engraved illustration depicting a nighttime scene. In the foreground, a person wearing a turban and light-colored clothing is crouched over another figure on the ground, holding a curved blade or knife aloft. In the background, standing near a doorway or wall, a second person wearing a head covering holds a lantern, illuminating the scene.
